scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof supplied with a reproducible exhaustive small-parameter comparison. Neither experiments nor same-model review are independent validation. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Finite, linear, ordered and noiseless Boolean-OR windows only; width h>=2 and output length m>=1. Asymptotics hold at fixed width. Elementary CA preimage enumeration, including Rule 254, predates this work; new assertions are the all-width exact image and singleton spectra and their distinct exponential growth rates. Unindexed equivalent results cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact output and unique-decoding spectra of binary sliding-OR sensors
